title: PlayerLimiter
description: Easily control server player limits with just one command.
body:
## 📜 Commands

* `/playerlimit` → Open Player Limit GUI
* `/playerlimit set <number>` → Set maximum player limit
* `/playerlimit reload` → Reload plugin configuration

## 🔐 Permissions

* `playerlimit.use` → Access the GUI
* `playerlimit.admin` → Manage limits & reload plugin
